fields.name: num
fields.coerce: none: used as a key, `player.items[num]`, when it is not `undefined`. A number or a numeric string works; `null` or any other value gives `invalid`
fields.description: The slot of a stand item: an item with `G.items[name].stand` (`stand0`, `stand1`, `computer` and `supercomputer` in G 17478). The server opens the stand with it. Any class can open a stand.

fields.name: close
fields.description: A true value closes the stand. With `num`, the server closes the stand and then opens it again with `num`.

responses.name: Success
responses.when: Always after the checks. With no `num` and no `close`, an open stand closes, and with no open stand nothing changes. If `num` is the stand item that is open now and `close` is not set, nothing changes and only this reply comes.

rows.when: `num` is present, and that slot is empty or does not hold a stand item.

also.when: The stand opened, closed or changed, or `num` is present. Before `merrit_status`.
also.summary: Your state without `reopen`. `stand` is the `stand` value of the item (`"stand0"`, `"stand1"` or `"cstand"`), or `false`. `slots` has the open trade slots. Clients nearby see the change in the next `entities` (`u`).

confirm.note: `stand_opened` is the `extra` of `market_patron_public_status`; the `reasons` come from node/logic/market_patron.js:29-67

order: `player` to you (only when something changed, or `num` is present)
